name: Agent Status
author: Matteo Moser
description: Shows open Claude Code and Codex sessions with the agent's mark and a live working/done indicator

barWidget.description: Open Claude Code / Codex sessions with working, done and attention state

schema.label: Maximum session name width
schema.description: Longer session names are elided at this width.

schema.label: Maximum sessions shown
schema.description: Sessions past this count are summed up in one "+n" chip, so the bar cannot grow into its center section.

schema.label: Done color
schema.description: Ring, checkmark and pulse once the agent is waiting for you.

schema.label: Attention color
schema.description: Ring while the agent needs a decision. Empty follows the theme's urgent color.
